description: Find recorded home sales around an address (radius), inside a drawn neighborhood outline (polygon of [latitude, longitude] points) or in a ZIP code, over the last 1-36 months, filtered by beds, baths, living sq ft, year built, price and property type. Returns each sale (address, date, price, price per sq ft, size, distance; no owner, buyer or seller names), median and quartile price and price per sq ft, a half-over-half trend, a price band when subjectSqft is given (or known from the county record), chart-ready series (chart.points, chart.monthly_median) and chart.image_url, a signed SVG chart an agent can open, save and show a seller. Use it for 'what did 3 bed homes near this street sell for in the last year' or 'what should we list at'. Show the chart (draw it from the series, or link chart.image_url) and quote the numbers exactly. King, Pierce and Snohomish county assessor records only; Snohomish has year built and property class but no size or bedrooms, and its dates are sale months. King condominium units may lack size and location. Statistics are not an appraisal. A miss is not charged. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.

inputSchema.description: Area + filters. Area is a subject address, a point, a polygon or a ZIP code.

address.description: Subject or center address; comps are searched within radiusMiles of it.
address.title: Address

county.description: Limit to one county. Recorded sales cover king, pierce and snohomish only; any other county returns a not-covered answer.
county.title: County

months.description: How many months back to include (default 12, up to 36).
months.title: Months

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around the address or point (default 0.5).
radiusMiles.title: Radius Miles

subjectSqft.description: Living sq ft of the home being priced, for the price band.
subjectSqft.title: Subject Sqft

zipCode.description: With an address, helps place it. Alone, searches the whole ZIP.
zipCode.title: Zip Code
